story.title: Crypto Is Winning in Washington Despite Clarity Act Failure, Says Policy Chief - Yahoo Finance

facts.text: Read the Original story Crypto Is Winning in Washington Despite Clarity Act Failure, Says Policy Chief by Darryn Pollock at beincrypto.com
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
In contrast, Bitwise Chief Investment Officer Matt Hougan concedes crypto's gains depend on agencies.
Smith leads the Solana Policy Institute, a crypto policy group.
The Senate rejected cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R.
3633 on September 15, 49–50, short of the 60 votes required.
Atkins had already said the next day that the Commission would act under existing authority.
The Crypto Times reported that pledge and the CFTC’s parallel statement .
SEC Chairman Paul Atkins said the agency will keep writing rules for on-chain fundraising after Congress failed to pass a crypto market-structure statute this month.

Speaking in Washington on September 29, he said : “Even though the CLARITY Act failed in Congress to be enacted, we are proceeding to provide clarity to the marketplace as far as how to raise money on chain.” He described a proposed rule already out and a second track covering how tokenized securities trade.
His answer was that the SEC’s framework resolves the problem by requiring the token to carry the security’s actual rights, which is what separates the American model from the offshore one.
The distinction is the central question in the tokenized-equity market.

Products offered to non-US investors by firms, including Ondo Finance , function as price trackers rather than direct ownership, while venues being built in the US are designed to preserve shareholder rights, including dividends and voting.
Atkins is saying the SEC will only sanction the second kind.
